name: Molu zhi Lü ~Gaoxiong Pian~
source:
In the year 20XX, the Taiwan Strait War erupted, igniting a massive conflict. However, due to the deadlock of the war, the mushroom cloud descended. The outcome of the war remained unknown, and the world entered the apocalypse.

Thirty years later, Taiwan spawned numerous autonomous regions. Although the world had fallen silent, people were still striving to build a new world amidst the ruins.

You will embark on a post-apocalyptic journey through our protagonist, Yang Qiongqi. Facing innumerable dangers, you will encounter the lost histories of a bygone era.

To fulfill a promise to her father, the young girl sets out on her journey.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464330/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
20XX年，台海战争爆发，引发大规模冲突。然而，由于战争的僵局，蘑菇云降临了。战争的结果仍然未知，世界进入了末日。

三十年后，台湾诞生了众多自治区。尽管世界陷入了沉寂，但人们仍在废墟中努力建设新的世界。

你将通过我们的主角杨琼琪踏上一段后末日之旅。面对无数的危险，你会遇到过去时代失落的历史。

为了履行对父亲的承诺，少女踏上了旅程。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464330/]Steam[/url]]
